items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: we’d take a break, that’s where we always ran across the alley to the saloon, Joe Harbor’s Spotlight, we went over there and grabbed a few belts

ctx.x: The TV thing was done live, so you had to be right on, no mistakes, or as few as possible.

No we were on, right from the beginning, boom, that was it. Like we rehearsed before in front, and then we’d take a break, that’s where we always ran across the alley to the saloon, Joe Harbor’s Spotlight, we went over there and grabbed a few belts, then ran back, and we were all set to record or to do the show, whichever we were doing. They always recorded the show anyway. Wow. There always had to be a bar across the street, of any place we played, there had to be a bar. In the dead of winter, right? No you…
